explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/808: the Erdős–Szemerédi graph sum-product conjecture was disproved by Alon–Ruzsa–Solymosi using sets of positive integers, with ≫ m^{5/3}/(log m)^{1/3} edges and |A+_GA| + |A·_GA| ≪ (m log m)^{4/3}. The statement negates the conjecture restricted to positive labels. Taking c = 0.6 and a small ε gives the contradiction. Faithful.
